notes.subject: פוץ
notes.rationale: Ol tanim i no wankain: sampela (KJV, JPS) i lukim em olsem tok bilong laikim — 'ol spring i go hariap'; sampela (ASV, BSB) i lukim em olsem askim — 'bilong wanem ol spring bilong yu i ken go long rot bilong ol arapela man?'

notes.subject: ol spring / ol liklik wara
notes.rationale: Piksa i go het: ol spring bilong man i no ken wok long givim wara long graun bilong ol arapela man — em i tok bilong pasin bilong marit.

translation: Ol spring bilong yu bai i go hariap i go ausait, long ol rot bilong ples, ol liklik wara i wok long go.

tokens.gloss: bai i go hariap i go
